about: Write r3-handoff/r3_screens.json: the Desk Dial r3 release-1 knob screens (presentation 6) for the harness.

r3.1 Music space playing: art at 0.8, MUSIC crumb, Home / Recent / Tracks / Pause
r3.1 Music space paused: keeps the art, dimmed to 0.45 (image_opa 143), status Paused, green Play icon and LED
r3.1 Music idle row (nothing loaded): Home (house) and Recent (album) at 26 px; Tracks and Play dimmed
r3.1 Recently Added: button 3 = Playlists (list-music icon), status with the artist, hold tick under button 4 (hold 4 = queue)
r3.1 Favourite playlists: MUSIC › PLAYLISTS crumb, button 3 lit amber (warm LED 0.9), songs instead of a year, hold tick
r3.1 Tracks = the whole queue: the queue ring (focus +-1 in its album colour, the playing row warm white 0.6, the rest off), no prev / dot / next row, green Play
r3.1 Tracks at the playing row: Turn to browse the queue; Play dimmed
r3.1 Up next on the queue ring (was selection), hold tick (hold 4 = play next)
r3.1 hold 4 on Home (launcher, holdMarker tick): the warm arc from 15 %, here 60 % of 1.0 s; the tap stays instant (on release)
r3.1 hold 4 landed on Home: knob to brightness, the ring flashes the Kelvin colour 0.68 for 450 ms (host: plain ok feedback)
r3.1 hold 4 back to volume: the ring flashes warm 0.68 for 450 ms
r3.1 hold 4 on Recently Added: queued, the ring flashes green 0.68 for 600 ms (host: ok + moment queued)
r3.1 Home lights domain, all off: Lights off / Tap 4 to turn on, ring off
r3.1 Lights blocked: Not connected / Home Assistant / Open Settings on your PC (red), ring off, buttons 2-4 dimmed
Home idle icon row: Music, Win, Lights (bulb 26 px), Play; no crumb
Warm end: Colour temperature 2200 K
Cool end: Brightness 100 % at 6500 K
Lights resting (5 s without input): steady warm 0.34 on the filled arc
Scene ran: the green wash (0.68, 700 ms) over the whole ring
20 scenes: 20 clusters of 3 fill the ring
